title: Pointwise relative flatness of algebraic-space modules
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], let $M$ be a module on the small etale ringed site of $X$ [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors], and let $x\in|X|$ [def-a1-space-point-topology]. Define $M$ to be relatively flat at $x$ over $Y$ if, for every compatible etale scheme-chart diagram $U\xrightarrow{h}V$ over $f$ and every $u\in U$ with image $x$, the ordinary Zariski stalk $(M_U)_u$ of the chart restriction $M_U$ [def-trf-space-module-scheme-restriction] [def-pc-module-stalk-functor] is flat over $\mathcal O_{V,h(u)}$ via $h^\sharp_u$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. For quasi-coherent $M$ [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module] this is the every-chart form of Stacks Tag 05VU and definition-flat-module. Neither chart is required to be surjective.
